text: I'm recommending the Brown Sugar Muffins recipe to you because it fits within your 45-minute time budget and doesn't require any special ingredients beyond what's commonly found in most kitchens. Although it's not a particularly low-sodium option, it's not excessively high either, with 242mg per serving. Given your goal of lowering your sodium intake, this recipe might not be the best choice, but it's a relatively quick and easy option that could be a nice indulgence every now and then.
